meta.title: RebaseRaven — a unified version control client
meta.description: RebaseRaven is an open-source, unified version control client for Git and Perforce. Review diffs and history on macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
language.label: Language
theme.label: Appearance
hero.title:
A unified
version control client.
hero.description: Review changes, follow history, and prepare commits or changelists in one desktop workspace.
preview.title: Try a change.
preview.label: Interactive demo · Sample data
preview.noscript: Enable JavaScript to try the interactive demo. Downloads and product details remain available.
preview.caption: Sample data only. Nothing changes in your repositories.
features.label: Made for your workflow
features.review.title: Review changes.
features.review.body: Read unified or split diffs, compare images, and stage Git changes by file, hunk, or line.
features.history.title: Browse history.
features.history.body: Explore Git graphs, branches, and file history. Review Perforce pending work, shelves, and submitted changelists.
features.context.title: Switch projects.
features.context.body: Keep repositories in tabs. Use the command palette, keyboard shortcuts, and light or dark themes.
workflow.title: Prepare the change.
workflow.intro: Git commits and Perforce changelists keep their own workflow, with consistent file review and history views.
workflow.git.title: Choose what to commit.
workflow.git.body: Review staged changes and leave unfinished work for later.
workflow.git.point2: Commit graph, branches, and file history
workflow.git.point3: Stashes, worktrees, submodules, and Git LFS workflows
workflow.p4.title: Organize the changelist.
workflow.p4.body: Group opened files and review pending or shelved changes before submission.
workflow.p4.point2: Workspace files, diffs, and revision history
workflow.p4.point3: Sync, reconcile, shelve, and submit workflows
principles.title: Your tools. Your workflow.
principles.cli.title: Built on your command-line tools
principles.cli.body: RebaseRaven runs Git and the Perforce CLI. Your repository configuration, hooks, and existing tool behavior remain part of the workflow.
principles.local.title: Diagnostics stay local
principles.local.body: Diagnostic files stay on your device and are not uploaded automatically.
principles.open.title: Open to inspection
principles.open.body: RebaseRaven is open source under the MIT License.
start.title: Set up your workspace.
start.step1.title: Install RebaseRaven
start.step1.body: Download the macOS Apple Silicon or Windows x64 release.
start.step2.title: Install your tools
start.step2.body: Install Git or the Perforce CLI (p4). Select it in Settings if needed. Git LFS repositories also require Git LFS.
start.step3.title: Open a repository
start.step3.body: Open, clone, or initialize a Git repository. Connect a Perforce workspace or create one from a stream or depot path.
faq.title: Before you install.
faq.systems.question: Which platforms are available?
faq.systems.answer: Download macOS Apple Silicon or Windows x64 builds. Linux users can build from source with the Tauri platform prerequisites.
faq.tools.question: Which command-line tools are required?
faq.tools.answer: Install Git for Git repositories, or the Perforce CLI (p4) for Perforce workspaces. Select the executable in Settings if needed.
faq.accounts.question: Where are my repositories stored?
faq.accounts.answer: Local repositories and workspace files stay on your device. Remote operations use Git or Perforce to connect to the servers you configure.
faq.demo.question: Does the demo change a real repository?
faq.demo.answer: No. It uses invented data in your browser. Staging, committing, shelving, and submitting never affect a real repository.

workflow.git.step1.title: Review the diff
workflow.git.step1.body: Read unified, split, or image diffs. Open the file in your editor for more context.
workflow.git.step2.title: Stage the change
workflow.git.step2.body: Stage a file, hunk, or selected lines. Review the staged diff before committing.

workflow.p4.step2.title: Organize and shelve

workflow.p4.step3.title: Submit and check history
